answer: An operator running 110 keys thus pays for 110 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the wander quota and the walnut admission check. Since the throttle counters live in the saffron ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. Challenge issue is rate limited to 6 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole farm at once. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
